"O Lord, how long shall I cry for help, and you will not hear?" When have you prayed like this?
"I am doing a work in your days that you would not believe if told." How might God be working in ways you can't see?
Habakkuk asks how a holy God can use the wicked. How do you wrestle with God's ways?
Habakkuk said, "I will take my stand at my watchpost... and look out to see what he will say to me." How can you wait expectantly for God?
"If it seems slow, wait for it; it will surely come." What are you waiting on God for?
"The righteous shall live by his faith." What does living by faith look like for you?
"The earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the waters cover the sea." How does this hope encourage you?
"The Lord is in his holy temple; let all the earth keep silence before him." How can you be still before God?
"O Lord, I have heard the report of you... In wrath remember mercy." What would you ask God to remember?
"Though the fig tree should not blossom... yet I will rejoice in the Lord." How can you rejoice in God when things fail?
"God, the Lord, is my strength; he makes my feet like the deer's." Where do you need God's strength?
